description: Windows Dynamic Island overlay with media controls, notifications, downloads, prayer times, and desktop widgets.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path "$dir\Nova Island.exe" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Nova Island.exe was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
if (!(Test-Path "$dir\resources\app.asar" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'resources\app.asar was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
if (!(Test-Path "$dir\resources\app.asar.unpacked\helper\nova-helper.exe" -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The unpacked Nova helper executable is missing.' }
notes: Uses the Electron Builder NSIS payload directly: Scoop extracts $PLUGINSDIR/app-64.7z into the version directory instead of running the setup program.

Scoop manages updates. The post-install hook sets autoUpdate=false in %APPDATA%\dynamic-nova\features.json because the application's built-in updater can replace files outside Scoop's version tracking.
Application settings and local data remain in %APPDATA%\dynamic-nova after uninstall; they are not stored in the Scoop version directory.
